summary: Add an unwired pure sidebar overlay and staged-write lifecycle

replay.detail: Unknown delivery reuses the exact staged actor, action identity, key, operations and fence; no replicated replay change.

schema.detail: Uses existing schema operations and crate-local records; no wire or durable journal format change.

compatibility.detail: Hosts remain unwired. Intent survives loading, acknowledgements wait for authoritative observation, and folder-first dependent membership staging requires persisted folder completion plus a fresh complete snapshot/revision and replanned memberships. Versioned journal serialization and crash restore remain outside this pure lifecycle module. StorageFailed now carries identity and a Pending, Completion or Removal persistence phase; adapters and ports must supply the identity and phase of the failed write. Only a matching identity and currently awaited pending/completion barrier can refuse; removal failures cannot undo observed completion.

recovery.detail: Explicit refusals retain intent and any partial folder success; retry requires a fresh confirmed base and unused identities. Superseded persistence failures are ignored, just like stale success callbacks.
